title: clearance-reads-a-notified-file-as-covered
intention: harbor_master's PROVED rung reads a hollow reading value {"notified": <notice id>} as covered, so a file the tester has sent to the operator no longer refuses PROVED, while an empty list, an unreadable reading, an empty reading and a marker that names no notice still refuse.
why: The tester will send a revert the proofs cannot see to the operator instead of redding it (Akien, open-ed0a56ce6357: complete AND notify). The PROVED rung reads the seal; until it knows the notified marker it would refuse the very crossing Akien ruled must complete.
traces_to: df05d93da4c0's falsifier (a) and Akien's answer to open-ed0a56ce6357 ("we let it complete AND notify me"); RULE 1 (the change stays inside harbor_master; the tester's marker is read off the seal, a record, never by reaching into the tester); Law 8's escape route: his answered question is the decision in the same act
how: In cairn/devices/cairn/machines/harbor_master/clearance.py hollow_lacks: before the unreadable census, collect the files whose reading is a dict with a non-empty string under 'notified'; exclude them from unreadable; the empty-list (hollow_file) and the empty-reading (hollow_nothing_measured) branches stay as they are. The docstring's value list gains the fourth value with the citation. A new proof beside clearance, test_a_notified_file_is_covered.py, drives hollow_lacks through its seal_reader parameter with fake seals: one notified file beside a covered file yields no lack; [] still reds hollow_file; {'unreadable': [...]} still reds hollow_unreadable; {'notified': ''} and {'notified': None} red hollow_unreadable; {} reds hollow_nothing_measured.
falsifier: 1: hollow_lacks over a code-seam whose reading is {'a.py': [tooth], 'b.py': {'notified': 'n-1'}} returns []. 2: the hard refusals stand — {'b.py': []} gives exactly hollow_file naming b.py; {'b.py': {'unreadable': ['p']}} gives exactly hollow_unreadable; {'b.py': {'notified': ''}} and {'b.py': {'notified': None}} give exactly hollow_unreadable naming b.py; {} gives exactly hollow_nothing_measured. RED if a notified file refuses, or if any of the four hard readings stops refusing. WRONG INTENT if Akien rules a notified file should hold the ticket. Horizon: this child PROVED.
watchme: none, because the live consumer is the PROVED rung itself on every code-seam crossing, and the producer's rate is the tester child's `notices` verb (parent df05d93da4c0's watchme: CairnCommons/tickets/df05d93da4c0-an-unvouched-green-completes-and-notifies.json)
children: none, because the change is one predicate in hollow_lacks and one proof
builder_notes: A Haiku builder needs: (1) the exact edit in clearance.py hollow_lacks, replacing the line `unreadable = sorted(f for f, r in reading.items() if not isinstance(r, list))` with: `notified = {f for f, r in reading.items() if isinstance(r, dict) and isinstance(r.get("notified"), str) and r["notified"].strip()}` then `unreadable = sorted(f for f, r in reading.items() if not isinstance(r, list) and f not in notified)`, with a comment citing df05d93da4c0 and open-ed0a56ce6357; and one bullet added to the docstring's value list: the key is present and names a NOTIFIED file -> covered (the tester sent the unvouched revert to the operator; Akien, open-ed0a56ce6357). (2) The proof at cairn/devices/cairn/machines/harbor_master/proofs/test_a_notified_file_is_covered.py: _REPO_ROOT = parents[6]; PROVES = {'0069ce6b8681': {'1': 'test_a_notified_file_is_covered', '2': 'test_the_hard_refusals_stand'}}; a helper that returns a seal_reader lambda yielding {'evidence': {'hollow': {tid: reading}}}; a ticket dict {'id': tid, 'node_class': 'code-seam'}; named = ['proofs/fake.py']; resolve hollow_lacks at call time (from ...clearance import hollow_lacks inside each test); main() prints ok/FAIL per tooth, GREEN or RED (n failed), exit 0 only when green. (3) Run test_clearance.py after the build: it must stay green.
